defects_found_during_execution.defect: Refusals discarded their audit record because the durable write ran only on the success path of the lock context.
defects_found_during_execution.resolution: The durable write was moved into a finally block so rejection records survive the exception.

defects_found_during_execution.defect: The crash injector conflated truncation with crashing, so the truncation path aborted before readback verification and the silent short write could not be exercised at all.
defects_found_during_execution.resolution: Truncation and process loss were split into independent controls, and both fault families are now covered by exhaustive matrices.

defects_found_during_execution.defect: Two test assertions encoded wrong expectations (a rung distance of 4 where the ladder distance is 5, and a less specific rejection reason).
defects_found_during_execution.resolution: The assertions were corrected to the observed classifications; the component was not weakened to fit them.

limitations: All eight components are dependency-free standard-library fixtures. They demonstrate and falsify custody properties; none is wired into a live coordinator.
Process loss is injected in-process rather than by SIGKILL, so operating-system write-back behaviour is exercised only indirectly.
Durability is demonstrated on a single host and filesystem; no multi-host, network-partition or clock-skew condition is exercised.
The recorded lost PO-02 Code-2 case is reproduced from its recorded shape in this repository, not from the original provider run, which is no longer observable.
